Alex Chen: Quick sync 3 we need the final launch commitments by EOD. Key lanes: SLA wording, pricing overflow, support runbook, monitoring checklist. Owners?

Mira Patel: Ill own the SLA and acceptance checklist. Will post a PR with exact wording today. :white_check_mark:

David Ortiz: Billing here 5 need rules for burst vs sustained and an overflow/backstop. Current matrix underestimates sustained 10k rps.

Sofia Ramos: Monitoring proposal: split text-gen vs embeddings. Hosted p95 <120ms, error <0.5%. Dedicated: p95 <200ms, error <0.3%. Add regression alerts tied to eval set.

Priya Singh: Support: GA = 24x5; escalate to oncall-sre for sev2+. Ill book a 30m handoff with support + oncall tomorrow 10:30 UTC. Who writes the canary rollback steps?

Mira Patel: Ill attach a short rollback runbook to the SLA PR: cut canary traffic, switch routing to fallback variant, scale dedicated if possible, notify stakeholders.

David Ortiz: For pricing: dev (free/light), standard (metered), dedicated (commit + discount). Proposed backstop: notify customer if autoscale costs >150% of commit; 72h to act or we throttle non-critical routes. Need legal signoff.

Alex Chen: Product okay with conservative backstop. @Priya prepare customer templates and CS briefing.

OpsBot: Deploy window reserved 2026-04-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Ack if required.

Alex Chen: Acked.

Sofia Ramos: Note: embeddings = best-effort for GA; publish median latencies in docs and commit p95 for Dedicated later.

Mira Patel: Opening SLA PR now, will ping reviewers when ready.

Alex Chen: Owners recap: SLA=Mira, Billing=David, Monitoring=Sofia, Support/Runbook=Priya+Alex. Meeting after SLA PR review. :rocket:
